review_kind: Independent source-model and production-path review; synthetic/fault proof is separate from live publication proof

findings.issue: Heading-only operative leaves and unknown empty DocTypes could qualify complete.
findings.resolution: Non-heading substantive body or explicit reserved/repealed disposition required; unknown DocTypes fail closed. Only source-backed publication landing exclusion is allowed.

findings.issue: Empty leaves, unowned page content and flat sibling body hierarchy could be lost or misowned.
findings.resolution: Explicit container/status dispositions, unowned text/asset rejection and source class ancestry plus breadcrumbs; legitimate headless definitions retain exact source IDs.

findings.issue: Unknown empty types, heading-only content, unowned visual/notes and generic aria-hidden removal could cause false completeness.
findings.resolution: Unknown/operative empties unresolved; non-heading substantive test; unowned text/notes/visual guard on every page; remove generic aria-hidden stripping.

findings.issue: A whole native export retaining top-level roots cannot independently prove middle branches.
findings.resolution: Verifier recursively reconstructs every retained section-toc branch and compares exact inventory/owners. Native export missing middle node fails even with all roots present.

findings.issue: Generic heading-only HTML and nested table rows could be misclassified or duplicated.
findings.resolution: Qualified legal marker plus substantive body/image placeholder; nested tables retain nearest-table own rows and parent index.

findings.issue: Extensionless source-explicit incorporated nonimage documents could evade required attachment coverage.
findings.resolution: Explicit adopted/incorporated standard/document contexts remain required or unresolved. They are not made optional by external hosting or a refusal.

findings.issue: Final user image policy requires placeholders, including image-only bodies, SVG/CSS/picture/dataURI/poster/object and nested table cells; early implementations left active image attributes.
findings.resolution: Normalized HTML/text uses literal[IMAGE], source identity retained, deliberate omission metadata, no active image tags/dataURI/CSS fetches in tested forms, no known-image acquisition calls. Earlier image-download expectations are superseded, and earlier raw evidence remains immutable.
findings.regression: test_image_policy.py; test_municode_edges.py; test_official_image_transport.py; test_american_image_transport.py; family no-image tests

findings.issue: Verification selected a family verifier without binding the requested target/publication to retained run; relative output could change meaning under subprocess cwd.
findings.resolution: Resolve output before dispatch; exact expected run config/client/product/publication binding before verifier, then family raw reconstruction. Same-family wrong government and same-client wrong product are negative tests.

findings.issue: A same-byte PDF cache crosswire could point an item at another source URL while preserving plausible parsed pages.
findings.resolution: Exact cached item/inventory equality, request-name/raw path and receipt URL/hash binding; source-crosswire fault. Per-item closing content checks supplement root inventory projection.

findings.issue: A same-ID body from another publication base could agree with a rewritten receipt/checkpoint.
findings.resolution: Verifier derives exact inventory/body/end URLs from configured publication base and requested source ID; final response origin/path stays pinned.
findings.regression: collectors/encodeplus/tests.py wrong-base same-ID rehashed source fault

findings.issue: Known URLs were initially too broadly considered runnable; generic primary titles and duplicate publication labels inflated apparent qualified scope.
findings.resolution: Qualified config dispatch only, observed publication titles/slugs/client aliases, deduplicate same source/selector, corrected eCode roots and Reno Administrative Code. Unqualified candidates retain reasons. Raw compact identity bundle makes relocated audit independent of original packages.

findings.issue: Municode independent probe script originally printed failed assertions with exit0.
findings.resolution: Exit2 for any failed probe,0 only when all pass; aggregate runner also parses machine-readable passed flag and disables socket networking.

findings.issue: HTTP200 empty or truncated required nonimage document bytes could satisfy attachment presence or PDF-prefix checks.
findings.resolution: Nonempty required bodies and concrete supported-format integrity checks are recomputed. Municode conservatively leaves PDFs/unknown formats unqualified without a format parser; eCode/enCodePlus/official PDF guards use their existing parsers. ZIP CRC/text-type checks remain byte-format outcomes, not legal semantic certification.

findings.issue: Normalized omission attributes copied full inline data:image payloads.
findings.resolution: Inline image strings become MIME/hash/source locator/character count metadata. Original raw source remains unchanged; normalized records and coverage do not copy pixels. Other four parsers already passed direct metadata inspection.

material_limits: Publication completion is separate from jurisdiction completeness; no government is certified complete by a primary book.
A full PDF/native-file or page pass does not establish legal-section segmentation, table/reading-order/OCR equivalence, vector image detection or image transcription.
Image placeholders deliberately omit image content; they preserve source position/identity and do not transcribe graphics.
Required nonimage asset gaps remain incomplete: Lincoln Access Management Policy retains Syracuse PDF DNS failure/host stop; San Diego ordinance index retains unresolved ordinance PDFs.
municipal.codes returned429 on Phoenix Charter/XI and remains stopped; partial retained traversal is not full publication completion.
Family offline tests and one representative full live proof do not make all mapped targets full-live verified.
